runtime_contract.authoritative_store: PhoneRuntime.store is the one file-backed hg.history.StateStore; SyncContext accepts injection and must receive the same object from PhoneRuntime.
runtime_contract.spool_sync: SyncContext owns staged inbox/outbox/conflict envelopes and provenance; imports validate the full batch before application and mark consumed inbox files.
runtime_contract.authenticated_spool_sync: Import requires safe JSON basename in inbox, rejects duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity, verifies AuthenticatedBatchGate, imports same parsed bytes/object, commits cursor after import, and requires cursor file path outside StateStore dir.
runtime_contract.sqlite_outbox: SQLiteStateStore and SyncDispatcher remain a separate transactional-outbox backend/adapter. This slice does not make file-backed StateStore and SQLiteStateStore one interchangeable class.
runtime_contract.history_v2_blocker: Actor/authority-attributed file-backed history V2 from circulatory source is not merged into hg/history.py. Its MutationPermit contract and strict cross-process file transaction semantics conflict with the older file-backed API; actor-authorized durable mutations are implemented in SQLiteStateStore. Needs an explicit canonical authority/backend decision.

changes: Added optional explicit authenticated sync wiring to PhoneRuntime while preserving existing edge constructor and methods.
SyncContext now accepts injected StateStore and validates its directory.
SyncContext import strictly rejects duplicate JSON keys, NaN/Infinity, arbitrary paths, traversal and symlink/non-inbox source paths.
Added transactional authenticated import path that validates gate before import and commits trusted cursor after idempotent import.
Added three source-derived spool hardening/recovery tests and two runtime single-store/cursor-boundary tests.
Updated manifest to declare current provenance and sync/auth/bootstrap modules.
